title: List 5-Star Hotel Suites and Nightly Rates
description_markdown: Hospitality request: Find all rooms of type 'suite' in hotels with a 5-star rating (`star_rating = 5`). Return `h.name AS hotel_name`, `r.room_number`, and `r.price_per_night`. Order by `r.price_per_night` DESC.
starter_query:
-- Luxury suites query
SELECT ...
solution_query: SELECT h.name AS hotel_name, r.room_number, r.price_per_night FROM hotels h JOIN rooms r ON h.hotel_id = r.hotel_id WHERE h.star_rating = 5 AND r.room_type = 'suite' ORDER BY r.price_per_night DESC, r.room_number ASC;
solution_explanation: Filters hotel inventory for top-tier accommodations.
hints: Join hotels and rooms on `h.hotel_id = r.hotel_id`.
Focus on the required WHERE, JOIN, or GROUP BY clause conditions.

Query: SELECT h.name AS hotel_name, r.room_number, r.price_per_night FROM hotels h JOIN rooms r ON h.hotel_id = r.hotel_id WHERE h.star_rating = 5 AND r.room_type = 'suite' ORDER BY r.price_per_night DESC, r.room_number ASC;

title: Calculate Total Guest Room Revenue
description_markdown: Front desk billing request: For guests with completed or confirmed reservations, calculate total booking amount (`SUM(total_amount)` as `total_room_spend`). Return `g.first_name`, `g.last_name`, and `total_room_spend`. Order by `total_room_spend` DESC.
starter_query:
-- Total spend per guest
SELECT ...
solution_query: SELECT g.first_name, g.last_name, SUM(r.total_amount) AS total_room_spend FROM hotel_guests g JOIN reservations r ON g.guest_id = r.guest_id WHERE r.status IN ('confirmed', 'checked_out') GROUP BY g.guest_id, g.first_name, g.last_name ORDER BY total_room_spend DESC, g.guest_id ASC;
solution_explanation: Aggregates revenue across completed stays.
hints: Join guests to reservations and filter out cancellations.
Focus on the required WHERE, JOIN, or GROUP BY clause conditions.

Query: SELECT g.first_name, g.last_name, SUM(r.total_amount) AS total_room_spend FROM hotel_guests g JOIN reservations r ON g.guest_id = r.guest_id WHERE r.status IN ('confirmed', 'checked_out') GROUP BY g.guest_id, g.first_name, g.last_name ORDER BY total_room_spend DESC, g.guest_id ASC;

title: Aggregate Room Service Revenue per Reservation
description_markdown: Concierge request: Calculate total room service ancillary charges (`SUM(charge)` as `service_charges`) per reservation. Join with `hotel_guests` and `rooms`. Return `g.last_name AS guest_name`, `rm.room_number`, and `service_charges`. Order by `service_charges` DESC, `g.last_name` ASC.
starter_query:
-- Ancillary charges
SELECT ...
solution_query: SELECT g.last_name AS guest_name, rm.room_number, SUM(rs.charge) AS service_charges FROM reservations r JOIN hotel_guests g ON r.guest_id = g.guest_id JOIN rooms rm ON r.room_id = rm.room_id JOIN room_services rs ON r.reservation_id = rs.reservation_id GROUP BY r.reservation_id, g.last_name, rm.room_number ORDER BY service_charges DESC, g.last_name ASC;
solution_explanation: Tracks secondary hotel revenue streams per reservation stay.
hints: Focus on the required WHERE, JOIN, or GROUP BY clause conditions.

Query: SELECT g.last_name AS guest_name, rm.room_number, SUM(rs.charge) AS service_charges FROM reservations r JOIN hotel_guests g ON r.guest_id = g.guest_id JOIN rooms rm ON r.room_id = rm.room_id JOIN room_services rs ON r.reservation_id = rs.reservation_id GROUP BY r.reservation_id, g.last_name, rm.room_number ORDER BY service_charges DESC, g.last_name ASC;

title: Rank Rooms by Nightly Tariff Within Each Hotel

title: Compile Guest Hospitality Stay and Incidental Spend Profile
description_markdown: For each guest, compute concatenated `guest_name`, total completed stays (`status = 'checked_out'`) as `completed_stays`, and sum of checked-out amounts as `room_charges_total`. Order by `room_charges_total` DESC, `completed_stays` DESC, `guest_id` ASC.
starter_query:

SELECT ...
solution_query: SELECT g.guest_id, (g.first_name || ' ' || g.last_name) AS guest_name, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status = 'checked_out' THEN 1 END) AS completed_stays, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'checked_out' THEN r.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0.0) AS room_charges_total FROM hotel_guests g LEFT JOIN reservations r ON g.guest_id = r.guest_id GROUP BY g.guest_id, g.first_name, g.last_name ORDER BY room_charges_total DESC, completed_stays DESC, g.guest_id ASC;
